## Deputies Elections

There have been 7 elections (7 contested) for Deputy held in St Saviour No 1 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (2 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Celia Scott-Warren](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/celia-scott-warren) and [Rob Duhamel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-duhamel) were elected as Deputies of St Saviour No 1 in 2002.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Celia Scott-Warren](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/celia-scott-warren)** |  | 531 | 57.9% |
| 2 | **[Rob Duhamel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-duhamel)** |  | 519 | 56.6% |
| 3 | [Kevin Lewis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis) |  | 374 | 40.8% |
| 4 | [Bob Mason](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bob-mason) |  | 240 | 26.2% |

917 ballots (inc. 10 spoilt papers)

2,355 registered voters

38.9% turnout
